message: The existing schema is a single `accounts` table with `username text NOT NULL UNIQUE` and nullable `display_name`. I’m shaping this as additive rolling steps: introduce a nullable handle, backfill it from the already-unique username, add uniqueness without blocking writes, then enforce requiredness through the skill’s staged PostgreSQL constraint pattern. `display_name` will remain untouched for the deprecation window.

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: C:\tmp\agent-skills-eval-postgres-skill-luna-router-01\migrations\002_add_account_handle.sql
+-- Rolling-deployment step 1: old application versions can continue to omit
+-- this column while the new application version starts populating it.
+ALTER TABLE accounts
+  ADD COLUMN account_handle text;
+
*** Add File: C:\tmp\agent-skills-eval-postgres-skill-luna-router-01\migrations\003_backfill_account_handle.sql
+-- Rolling-deployment step 2: username is already unique, so copying it gives
+-- every existing row a deterministic unique handle without a lossy transform.
+-- The NULL predicate keeps this migration safe to rerun and avoids replacing
+-- handles written by a concurrently deployed application version.
+UPDATE accounts
+SET account_handle = username
+WHERE account_handle IS NULL;
+
*** Add File: C:\tmp\agent-skills-eval-postgres-skill-luna-router-01\migrations\004_add_account_handle_unique_index.sql
+-- Rolling-deployment step 3. Run this migration outside a transaction:
+-- CONCURRENTLY keeps reads and writes available while the index is built.
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY accounts_account_handle_uidx
+  ON accounts (account_handle);
+
*** Add File: C:\tmp\agent-skills-eval-postgres-skill-luna-router-01\migrations\005_add_account_handle_not_null_check.sql
+-- Rolling-deployment step 4: once all deployed writers populate the handle,
+-- record the invariant without taking an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE validation lock.
+ALTER TABLE accounts
+  ADD CONSTRAINT accounts_account_handle_not_null
+  CHECK (account_handle IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID;
+
*** Add File: C:\tmp\agent-skills-eval-postgres-skill-luna-router-01\migrations\006_validate_account_handle_not_null.sql
+-- Rolling-deployment step 5: validate the backfill while allowing reads and
+-- writes to continue. This must succeed before the metadata-only final step.
+ALTER TABLE accounts
+  VALIDATE CONSTRAINT accounts_account_handle_not_null;
+
*** Add File: C:\tmp\agent-skills-eval-postgres-skill-luna-router-01\migrations\007_set_account_handle_not_null.sql
+-- Rolling-deployment step 6: the validated CHECK lets PostgreSQL perform this
+-- as a fast metadata change instead of rescanning the table.
+ALTER TABLE accounts
+  ALTER COLUMN account_handle SET NOT NULL;
+
+-- display_name remains during the deprecation window so older application
+-- versions can continue reading it. Retire it in a later, separately reviewed
+-- destructive migration after those versions are no longer deployed.
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
